question:
**Choose the correct meaning of the given idiom.**

By leaps and bounds
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Rapidly'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"by leaps and bounds"** is used to describe something that is improving, increasing, or growing very quickly. (तेजी से).

 
 
• **For example-** "Her English is improving by leaps and bounds".
 
 
 
• **'Rapidly' **is the most appropriate meaning for this idiom, which signifies 'very quickly and in a short time'.(तेजी से).
 
 
• **For example- **"The company's fortunes were improving rapidly".
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 4'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Slowly'** means at a slow speed; not quickly. (धीरे धीरे)
 
• **'Abruptly'** means suddenly and unexpectedly. (अचानक)
 
• **'Stealthily' **means behaving, done, or made in a cautious and surreptitious manner. (चुपके से)
